news.title: Oil slides for a fourth session
news.text: Brent is near $101.5 (−2.3%) and WTI near $97.9 (−2.4%) as Saudi crude exports recover (over 4M b/d in September vs 2.4M in August) and hopes build that US–Iran talks resume. XOM −2.1% and CVX −1.1% at 09:48 ET.

news.title: US–China talks lift chips ahead of Thursday's summit
news.text: Treasury Secretary Bessent called talks with China's He Lifeng "very successful" and proposed an AI incident-alert channel. Trump and Xi meet Thu 24 Sep; chip-export controls are the key swing factor. Pre-market: AMD about +3%, MU +2%, TSM +1%.

news.title: Arista joins the S&P 100 today
news.text: Effective at today's open, Arista replaces Nike in the S&P 100, along with Dell, Palo Alto Networks and SanDisk (announced 4 Sep). Index-tracking flows can add a one-day bid; it is not a change in the business.

news.title: Traders price in more Fed hikes, yet yields dipped pre-open
news.text: After Wednesday's 25 bp hike, traders "rushed to price in" further increases, while Treasury yields eased ahead of the summit. The 10-year closed Friday at 5.01%.

news.title: Accenture +6% on an Anthropic tie-up
news.text: Accenture will partner with Anthropic, with both investing at least $1B to build capacity. IT-services read-through only; none of your names is directly involved.

news.title: Nothing new on the rest; one date to remember
news.text: No fresh overnight news found for GNRC, MTSI, VICR, ETSY, MTCH, ARW or GOOGL, and none at sector level for Communication Services. TD Synnex (SNX) reports Thu 24 Sep before the open, call at 9:00 ET.
